message.content: In the conversation, Fionnuala shared a humorous glitch she experienced in the game Red Dead Redemption 2. She mentioned that during a mission, her character Arthur ended up floating in mid-air after a cutscene. Despite Arthur hanging there for a minute, Fionnuala was able to continue the mission and drop down without any issues. This glitch resulted in a comical situation where Arthur just floated in the air, breaking the tension of the moment. Fionnuala described how this incident made her laugh despite the unexpected and bizarre outcome.
